rationale: The held ProQuest text confirms EO 2489 (Wilson, 21 November 1916) reserves only NE1/4 sec. 21, T. 28 S., R. 8 W., N.M.P.M., and both held EO 8376 texts (FR 5 FR 1077 and APP) match the cited spans and hashes: paragraph 2, signed 13 March 1940, revokes EO 2489 by number with no savings clause; the full-corpus number sweep finds only those two citations, so no earlier end appears. The NO status and actor/mechanism are therefore supported, but the proposed interval is wrong and contradicts the decision's own rationale: it gives start 1913-11-21 (the order is dated 1916-11-21) and end 1937-03-13 (EO 8376 was signed 1940-03-13). A proposal with wrong dates cannot be accepted even though the status looks right.
